chunks: From him, from al-Sindi ibn Muhammad, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I said to Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s.): [What is] the wudu that Allah has made obligatory upon the servants — for one who comes from the toilet or has urinated?
He said: «He washes his penis and removes the excrement, then performs wudu [washing each limb] twice twice.»

key_terms.الْغَائِطِ: excrement; euphemism for defecation and toilet (cause of minor ritual impurity)
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice; each limb of wudu washed two times

ai.seo_question: What wudu does Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) prescribe after using the toilet or urinating?
ai.summary: Yunus ibn Ya'qub asked Imam Abu 'Abd Allah al-Sadiq (a.s.) about the wudu that Allah has made obligatory upon His servants for one who has relieved himself or urinated. The Imam prescribed washing the private part, removing the excrement, then performing wudu washing each limb twice — establishing the double-washing (marratayn marratayn) as the obligatory standard.
